description: Thursday 06:55: the 1910 Broadway Facilities Desk emails Ryan, in a new thread, a photo of the room board as revised: Thursday's PRIDE graduation crossed out of Training Room 2B (no heat) and written into the Conference Center 1C row, 6-9p. The body names only the attachment, which lands in the Mail app's attachment store. Unread. Nothing announces it. Thursday 06:50: Coach David Parker asks to borrow a folding table, for the team party on Sunday in a WhatsApp message to Ryan (unannounced).

filesystem.description: The attachment of the 1910 Broadway Facilities Desk's mail, in the Mail app's attachment store. Facilities moves Thursday's graduation to Conference Center Room 1C.

row.text: Marcus said you might have a folding table we could borrow for the team party Sunday?
